messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Technology and IT Services" as it appears in the following examples.
['This e-mail has been sent to you by HSBC Bank plc to inform you that we were unable to verify your account details.', 'Your university account has been filed under the list of accounts set for deactivation due to the retirement/graduation of the concerned account holder.', 'With this automatic renewal, you will continue to have uninterrupted antivirus software protection on your PC for another year plus these great benefits:', 'New Service Pack v6.7.8 update is ready for download.', 'You will not be able to access your Intuit QuickBooks account without Intuit Security Tool (IST#8482;) after 31st of October 2011.', 'We would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out scheduled maintenance of banking software, that operates customer database for MONA Bank online services.', 'Abbey Customer Service would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out a scheduled upgrade of Abbey Security software.', 'Please use the link below to complete your update to the new server.', "That's why we've teamed up with the financial security experts at Trustees to bring you their Rapport security software, which will:"]

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
